## Description

"FM/AM tuner with PLL MPX circuit.Two dual-gate MOS FETs are used for the FM front-end section.As a result, the AGC (Automatic Gain Control) characteristics have been greatly improved. Any strength of radio waves (100Ï‰ V to 1,000,000Ï‰ V) can be converted into an IF signal of almost constant strength by the AGC and input to the IF amplifier stage. Thus, various characteristics such as distortion factor, separation and selectivity are hardly affected by the strength of radio waves.We have adopted a 7-train varicon consisting of 4-train FM and 3-train AM.The FM stereo demodulation circuit uses a PLL (Phase Locked Loop) circuit.In order to demodulate a stereo composite signal, it is necessary to extract the 19kHz pilot signal contained in the signal and produce a 38kHz signal. Conventional tuners use a frequency multiplication method that takes advantage of the nonlinearity of the element. This method requires two or three coils, and the IC demodulator provides sufficient separation. However, the use of multiple coils causes an adjustment error due to changes over time, so that initial separation cannot be guaranteed. Moreover, if the Q of the coil is increased enough to withstand external noise, it becomes more vulnerable to changes over time.The PLL circuit has a function to automatically match the phase relationship between the pilot signal and the 38kHz signal, so the deterioration of separation due to phase shift is extremely small. In addition, the adjustment position corresponding to 2-3coils is only one semi-fixed volume, so it is resistant to change with time. Moreover, even if phase shift occurs, it is automatically adjusted. In addition, it is equipped with frequency selection and oscillation frequency persistence (short-time memory), so it is resistant to noise compared with a tuning circuit using coils and stable stereo demodulation can be expected.Two ICs are used in the FM IF stage, and a four stage differential amplifier circuit is constructed by these ICs to provide a sufficient limiter.The selectivity is also improved by combining three ceramic filters and one IFT.Uses RFB (Radio Frequency Bypass) and AGC.The RFB and AGC installed at the entrance of radio waves have a role of suppressing a sudden increase in distortion even if the tuner receives an excessive input when a broadcasting station increases output to eliminate interference.This makes it possible to receive stable AM broadcasts.Equipped with volume for output adjustment.It is equipped with a high blend switch so that when a station with a weak input signal is received, the noise can be eliminated without losing the stereo effect.It is equipped with an FM muting switch to shut out noise between stations and during detuning.It is equipped with 2large meters."
